purpose: Outcome-blind pre-screen audit of the remaining Cohort 001 mechanisms against known active/rejected/deprioritized strategy designs. This is advisory preparation only and does not substitute for the repaired #507 canonical label-invariant semantic admission gate.

canonical_comparators.mechanism: broad cross-sectional participation predicting subsequent market direction
realized funding pressure as a directional predictor for 24h/7d returns
large one-hour high-volume/wide-range liquidity shock followed by six-hour reversal
ATR compression followed by 20-bar price breakout continuation
BTC impulse followed by beta-defined ETH/SOL underreaction continuation

audits.reason: Both test breadth/participation as a market-wide persistence signal and canonical COORD-DATA-005 is actively owned. Exact rules differ, but duplication risk is material enough to hold this seed before screening.

The comparator ranks a broad survivor-prone cross-section for residual continuation over a 24h horizon. This seed uses only fixed ETH/SOL versus BTC, explicitly trades opposite extreme six-hour beta residuals as a beta-hedged pair, and tests short-horizon reversion. Direction, portfolio construction, universe contract, holding horizon and causal mechanism differ materially. Canonical semantic admission remains mandatory.

The rejected comparator requires a single large one-hour return shock plus abnormal volume and range, then reverses it. This seed aggregates four-hour signed candle-body/quote-volume pressure, excludes extreme range, requires close-location confirmation and trades continuation for three hours. It is not a threshold rescue of the rejected shock-reversal design.

The rejected design specifically interprets high-volume, wide-range one-hour shocks as forced-flow overshoot. This seed requires an eight-hour drift with depressed participation and explicitly excludes extreme hourly range, hypothesizing weak-information drift rather than forced-flow depletion. Mechanism and conditioning are opposite on participation/range.

This is a fixed calendar/liquidity-handoff hypothesis measured over the weekend and closed during early Monday, not a generic one-hour shock reversal. Main risk is statistical power because independent weekends are scarce; if underpowered it must be classified inconclusive rather than thresholds widened.

The rejected design selects low-ATR compression then a 20-bar range breakout with ATR stop/target. This seed selects three same-sign hourly returns only inside a trailing moderate-volatility band with ordinary participation and uses a fixed three-hour continuation hold. It contains no compression or range-breakout trigger.

This seed requires a low-efficiency 24h regime and a close at the outer edge of the prior 48h range on non-extreme volume, with midpoint/ATR exits. The rejected design requires an abnormal one-hour return/volume/range shock and a fixed six-hour reversal. The range-auction mechanism does not reuse the rejected shock threshold or liquidity-depletion condition.

DATA-FUNDING-001 used realized funding pressure to predict future directional crypto return. This seed proposes a delta-neutral long-spot/short-perpetual hedge intended to harvest realized positive funding carry without a directional price forecast, subject to two-leg transaction costs and basis risk. The execution premise and target PnL source are materially different, but screening remains blocked until an exact synchronized spot/perp/funding dataset is frozen and the canonical semantic gate accepts it.

global_findings.reason_screenable_now: PR #507 canonical semantic rejected-design gate is not integrated; Cohort 001 identities must be regenerated against that implementation before any outcome inspection.
global_findings.replacement_reason: Do not manufacture a new hypothesis merely to maintain a target cohort count. Six non-breadth OHLCV designs already remain for post-gate preflight, while carry has a real data blocker.
